# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the sequence: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Every one of those commands assumes resistance. You don't stand firm when the ground is level and the enemy is absent. You stand firm when the pressure comes and everything in you wants to retreat.

Brothers, the world will tell you that strength is toxic, that conviction is narrow, that discipline is unnecessary. But God calls men to something higher. He calls us to be awake when others are asleep, to hold the line when others fold, to lead when it costs us. This strength is not your own—it flows from a heart surrendered to Christ. Real men are not those who never feel fear; they are those who act in faith despite it.

Today, you will face a thousand small chances to compromise. Take the harder road. Stand where God has placed you. Your family, your church, and your brothers are watching. Be strong—not for your glory, but for His.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, declare "I stand firm in the faith." Then pray for one man in your life who needs strength today.
